neighbours.label: in code, the variable repeated on the right-hand side of a self-update assignment (x = x + 1, tries = tries - 1): fires on the second mention, just before the + or -; an assignment from a different variable is quiet. The + pole promotes the opposite continuation (it suppresses ' +', ' plus', ' minus')

notes: Probes: 'n = n - 1' 0.86, 'score = score + 1' 0.66, 'count = count + 1' 0.55; 'score = bonus + 1' 0.07, 'm = n - 1' 0.26.
